question.text: Which one of the following is formed (mainly) when red phosphorus is heated in a sealed tube at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>803</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo>?</mo></math>

solution.text: When red phosphorous is heated in a sealed tube at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>803</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math>-black phosphorous is formed.
